Moreover, the company has demonstrated robust sales growth over the trailing twelve months at 20% [E17], which is notably higher than the sector median sales growth of 10.4% [E77]. This indicates that STARCEMENT is outperforming the broader market in terms of revenue expansion. However, these metrics do not necessarily negate the recent strong performance indicators.
